To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed design of 6t SRAM cell based CNFET shows improved performance compared to the conventional design of SRAM cell based 6t SRM cell.
the SNM of the SRAM cell is improved by 38% for the read operation, 12% for the standby mode operation and 20% for the write operation.
the 6T SRAMS cell design based on CNFET shows improved performance in terms of noise margin and power compared to the traditional 6T SRM cell design based on 32 nm CMOS technology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of 6T CNFET SRAM cell considering transistor ratio.
the design of 6-T SRAM cell with improved SNM for read operation.
the design of a high SNM SRAM cell with low power dissipation using 32nm CN FET.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed design of 6t SRAM cell using CNFET is more reliable, robust and efficient than traditional 6t CMOS SRAM cell.
32nm CN FET based SRAM cell shows excellent performance compared to the traditional 6T SRM cell.
the 32nm CN FET based 6 T SRAM cell is better than 32nm CM OS based 6 T cell in terms of SNM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
by considering proper transistor ratio the SRAM cell design shows improved performance compared to the conventional CMOS based SRAM cell design.

we have designed the CNFET based SRAM cell with low nanotubes diameter and proper transistor sizing which gives high SNM, low leakage current, high speed and low power dissipated in submicron technology.
we have achieved high SNM for read operation and standby mode operation with low nanotubes diameter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CNFET based SRAM cell can achieve better performance in terms of noise margin and power dissipation.
the 32nm CN-FET based 6t SRAM cell can provide high static noise margin and high performance with low nanotubes diameter.
the proposed 6T SRAMS cell design based on 32 nm CNFET can be used in future technology.
